Name: Autistic Pride Flags for Custom Furniture (CF)
Author: eorrl
Description:
Hey!

This mod adds 6 different flags related to autistic pride to Robin's shop and the furniture catalogue. Those flags are the autistic pride infinity symbol & the gold variant of it, the Twainbow flag meant to represent LGBTQ+ autistic people, a rainbow flag featuring the infinity symbol, and two different autigender pride flags.

I decided to create this as a separate mod from my LGBTQ+ Pride Flags furniture pack, since not all of these flags are relevant to that.

Unzip directly into your Stardew Valley mods folder to install!

Note: I would recommend installing manually, since there are sometimes issues using Vortex with Custom Furniture.

Happy April, hope you enjoy :)

- Eorrl
